# Synthetic Password Reset

用户可通过一次性链接重置密码。链接 30 分钟后失效；重置成功后旧密码立即失效；链接只能使用一次。

assertions.text: Creates all five stage artifacts in the named directory
assertions.script: DIR=testspec/changes/synthetic-password-reset && test -f "$DIR/requirements.md" && test -f "$DIR/requirements-analysis.md" && test -f "$DIR/specs/testpoints.md" && test -f "$DIR/artifacts/testcases.json" && test -f "$DIR/review-report.md" && echo PASS || echo FAIL

assertions.text: Propagates the complete revision envelope through review
Generates executable cases with TP traceability
assertions.script: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('testspec/changes/synthetic-password-reset/artifacts/testcases.json')); assert d['testcases'] and all(c.get('tp_refs') and c.get('steps') and c.get('expected_result') for c in d['testcases']); print('PASS')" 2>/dev/null || echo FAIL
test ! -e testspec/testlib && echo PASS || echo FAIL

evals.expected_output: points、testcases 和 review context 都保持 revision 2，各阶段依次消解自身 stale 标记。
